data.name: Somveer
data.long_meaning: Somveer is a combination of two Sanskrit words, ‘Som’ and ‘Veer’. ‘Som’ refers to Lord Shiva, the God of the Universe, and ‘Veer’ means brave or strong. Thus, Somveer is the name of the Lord of the Universe, who is believed to be the source of all strength and courage.
data.spiritual_meaning: Somveer is a powerful spiritual name that is believed to bring blessings of strength, courage, and protection from Lord Shiva.
